editorial:
Imagine your carefree life flipping upside down when a baby is suddenly left on your doorstep. That is exactly what happens to Samuel, a fun-loving guy who drops everything to find the mother in London. Instead of finding her, he builds a whole new life as a stuntman and devoted dad to his daughter Gloria. The movie mixes big laughs with real heart, showing how messy but beautiful parenthood can be. You will feel the warmth between father and daughter right away, and the London backdrop adds a bright, lively energy to every scene.

Omar Sy shines with his natural charm and emotional range, making Samuel feel like a real person you would want as a friend. The pacing keeps things moving, though some dramatic turns feel a bit rushed near the end. If you enjoy feel-good family stories with a few tears, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, you learn Gloria has been seriously ill all along. Kristin returns and fights for custody, but Samuel proves his deep bond with his daughter. Just as things seem settled, Gloria's health declines and she passes away. The closing scene shows Samuel continuing his daily routine while imagining Gloria still by his side, revealing the whole story was his way of keeping her memory alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good family stories with heart and humor.
